page-hero.p-how-agree-technologies: How Agree Technologies collects, processes and protects your personal data, and which cookies this website places on your device.

cookies.p-this-website-uses-cook: This website uses cookies. We use them to remember your consent choice, to protect our contact form from automated abuse, and to measure how the site is used so that we can improve it. We do not use cookies for advertising, we do not build profiles of visitors, and we do not share your browsing data with social media or advertising networks. Cookies are small text files that a website can place on your device.
cookies.p-the-law-states-that: The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary to ensure the provision of the service you have expressly requested to use. For all other types of cookies, we must obtain your consent.
cookies.p-this-website-uses-diff: Some of these cookies are set by third-party services used on our pages. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer of every page. Details of who we are, how to contact us and how we process personal data are in the privacy policy below.
cookies.p-when-we-place-cookies: When we place cookies, you are informed about the use and purpose of collecting data via cookies.
cookies.h3-we-place-cookies-on: We place cookies on your device for the following purposes:
cookies.li-necessary-functions-th: Necessary functions the website cannot work without, including spam protection on our forms
cookies.li-statistics-and-improve: Statistics and improvement of the site
cookies.li-protecting-our-forms-a: Advertising measurement, if you accept marketing cookies
cookies.h3-we-place-cookies-on-2: We place cookies on your device from the following partners:
cookies.p-when-you-visit-agree: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors find and use this site — which pages are read, which search terms lead here, and roughly where in the world visitors are. This happens only if you accept statistics cookies. Our Google Analytics property is also linked to a Google Ads account. We do not currently run advertising campaigns, but if you accept marketing cookies, data about your visit may be shared with Google Ads; if you decline them, no advertising data is sent.
cookies.p-we-also-share-informat: Event-level statistics data is deleted automatically after 2 months. User-level data is deleted 14 months after your last visit; if you visit again within that period, it starts again.
cookies.p-when-you-visit-agree-2: Our contact form is protected by hCaptcha, which checks that a submission comes from a person rather than an automated script. For that check, hCaptcha receives your IP address and basic information about your browser. It is used only on the contact page and only for security. Because the form could not safely be offered without it, it is treated as a necessary cookie and does not require your consent.
cookies.p-before-we-place-cookie: We ask for your consent before placing statistics cookies. Cookies that are strictly necessary — remembering your consent choice and protecting our forms — are used without consent, as the law permits.
cookies.h3-this-is-how-long: This is how long cookies are stored
cookies.p-cookies-delete-themsel: Cookies expire after a set period, which varies by provider. Your consent choice is stored for 12 months, after which you will be asked again. Some cookies are deleted as soon as you close the browser window.
cookies.p-if-you-do-not: You can change your choice at any time using the Cookie settings link in the footer. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings; every major browser offers this under its privacy or security settings.
cookies.p-your-consent-applies-t: Your consent applies to the following domains: agree-tech.com

policy.p-we-process-your-person: We process your personal data and have therefore adopted this privacy policy, which tells you how we collect and process information about you. The privacy policy applies to personal data that you submit to us or that we collect via the website agree-tech.com. All inquiries to us can be made via the contact details listed below.
policy.p-agree-technologies-is-: Agree Technologies is the data controller, and we ensure that your personal data is processed in accordance with the law.
policy.p-agree-technologies-aps: Agree Technologies ApS, Copenhagen, Denmark. Email: info@agree-tech.com
policy.p-when-we-ask-you: When we ask you to make your personal data available to us, we inform you about which data we process about you and for what purpose. You receive information about this at the time of collection of your personal data.
policy.p-we-use-data-about: We use data about you primarily to fulfil the agreements you enter into with us, and secondarily to improve our service, to ensure quality in our products and services, and in our contact with you.
policy.p-when-you-visit-agree: When you visit this website we collect information about your use of it — the type of browser you use, the pages you view, the search terms that brought you here, your IP address and approximate location. This happens through Google Analytics, and only if you accept statistics cookies.
policy.p-the-legal-basis-for: The legal basis for the processing is the EU Personal Data Regulation, art. 6, subsection 1, letter f.
policy.p-when-you-sign-up: When you submit our contact form, we collect the name, business email address, company and any message you provide.
policy.p-the-purpose-is-to: The purpose is to answer your enquiry and, where you have ticked the consent box, to send you material about our products. The legal basis is the EU General Data Protection Regulation, article 6(1)(f), and article 6(1)(a) where you have given consent.
policy.p-information-about-your: Information about your name, address, e-mail, mobile number and other submitted data will be passed on to our salespeople and other personnel who may be necessary to answer your inquiry.
policy.p-information-can-be-lef: Information may be passed to external partners who process it on our behalf. We use external partners for the technical operation of the website, for delivering contact form submissions to us, and for website statistics.
policy.p-these-companies-are-da: These companies are data processors and, under our instructions, process the data for which we are the data controller.
policy.p-the-data-processors-ma: The data processors may not use the information for any purpose other than fulfilling their agreement with us, and are subject to confidentiality. Our data processors are Netlify (website hosting and server logs), Web3Forms (delivery of contact form submissions), hCaptcha (spam protection on the contact form) and Google (website statistics and advertising measurement). International data transfer may occur: these providers may process personal data outside the EU/EEA. We ensure an adequate level of protection by relying on the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.
policy.h3-4-we-only-process: 4. We only process relevant and necessary personal data
policy.p-we-only-process-data: We only process data about you that is relevant and sufficient in relation to the purposes defined above. The purpose is decisive for which type of data about you is relevant to us. The same applies to the extent of the personal data we use. For example, we do not use more data than we need for the specific purpose.
policy.p-we-only-collect-proces: We only collect, process and store the personal data that is necessary in relation to fulfilling our stated purposes. In addition, the type of data that is necessary to collect and store for our business operations may be determined by law. The type and extent of the personal data we process may also be necessary to fulfill a contract or other legal obligation.
policy.h3-5-we-delete-your: 5. We delete your personal data when they are no longer needed
policy.p-we-delete-your-persona: We delete your personal data when they are no longer necessary in relation to the purpose for which we collected, processed and stored your data.
policy.p-general-inquiries-are-: General inquiries are stored until we have delivered your requested services (maximum 2 years).
policy.h3-6-we-obtain-your: 6. We obtain your consent before we process your personal data
policy.p-we-obtain-your-consent: We obtain your consent before we process your personal data for the purposes described above, unless we have a legal basis for obtaining it. We inform you of such a basis and of our legitimate interest in processing your personal data.
policy.p-your-consent-is-volunt: Your consent is voluntary and you can withdraw it at any time by contacting us. Use the contact details above if you would like further information.
policy.h3-7-we-do-not: 7. We do not pass on your personal data without your consent
policy.p-if-we-pass-on: If we pass on your personal data to business partners and actors, among other things for marketing purposes, we obtain your consent and inform you of what your data will be used for. You can object to this type of disclosure at any time.
policy.p-we-do-not-obtain: We do not obtain your consent if we are legally obliged to pass on your personal data, e.g. as part of a report to an authority.

rights.p-in-order-to-create: In order to create transparency around the processing of your information, we, as the data controller, must inform you of your rights.
rights.p-you-are-entitled-at: You are entitled at any time to request information from us about, among other things, what information we have registered about you, what purpose the registration serves, which categories of personal data and recipients of information there may be, as well as information about where the information originates.
rights.p-you-have-the-right: You have the right to receive a copy of the personal data that we process about you. If you want a copy of your personal data, send a written request to our email address: info@agree-tech.com. You may be asked to document that you are who you say you are.
rights.p-you-have-the-right-2: You have the right to have incorrect personal data corrected by us. If you become aware that there are errors in the information we have registered about you, you are encouraged to contact info@agree-tech.com in writing so that the information can be corrected.
rights.p-in-certain-cases-you: In certain cases, you have the right to have all or certain personal data deleted, e.g. if you withdraw your consent and we have no other legal basis to continue the processing.
rights.p-to-the-extent-that: To the extent that continued processing of your information is necessary, e.g. in order for us to comply with our legal obligations, or for legal claims to be established, asserted or defended, we are not obliged to delete your personal data.
rights.h3-8-4-the-right: 8.4 The right to limit processing to storage
rights.p-in-certain-cases-you-2: In certain cases, you have the right to have the processing of your personal data limited to storage only, e.g. if you believe that the information we process about you is incorrect.
rights.p-in-certain-cases-you-3: In certain cases, you have the right to have personal data that you have provided yourself delivered in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and have the right to transfer this data to another data controller.
rights.p-you-have-the-right-3: You have the right at any time to object to our processing of your personal data for the purpose of direct marketing, including the profiling that is carried out in order to be able to target our direct marketing.
rights.p-you-also-have-the: You also have the right at any time, for reasons relating to your personal situation, to object to the processing of your personal data by us on the basis of our legitimate interests.
rights.p-you-have-the-right-4: You have the right at any time to revoke a consent given to us for a given processing of personal data. If you wish to revoke your consent, contact info@agree-tech.com.
rights.p-you-have-the-right-5: You have the right to lodge a complaint at any time with the Danish Data Protection Agency, Borgergade 28, 5, 1300 København K, about our processing of your personal data. Complaints can be lodged, among other things, by email dt@datatilsynet.dk or telephone +45 33 19 32 00.

security.p-we-have-implemented-ap: We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational security measures against personal data being accidentally or illegally destroyed, lost, changed or degraded, as well as against unauthorized access or misuse.
security.p-only-employees-who-hav: Only employees who have a real need to access your personal data to perform their work have access to it.
security.p-information-collected-: Information collected about your use of the website, cf. pt. 2, is deleted automatically: event-level data after 2 months, and user-level data 14 months after your last visit.
security.p-information-collected--2: Information collected when you submit our contact form is deleted once your enquiry has been dealt with, and at the latest after 2 years, unless you have consented to further contact or we have another basis for continuing to process it.
security.p-information-collected--3: Information collected in connection with a commercial relationship will basically be deleted 3 years after the end of the calendar year in which the relationship ended. However, information can be stored for a longer period if we have a legitimate need for longer storage, e.g. if it is necessary for legal claims to be established, asserted or defended, or if storage is necessary for us to comply with legal requirements. Accounting material is stored for 5 years until the end of a financial year in order to meet the requirements of the Danish Bookkeeping Act.
security.h3-11-changes-in-the: 11. Changes in the personal data policy
security.p-if-the-privacy-policy: If the privacy policy changes, you will be informed of this on your next visit to the website.
